sections.heading: Achieve Global Compliance with Confidence
paragraphs: Manufacturing high-frequency surgical equipment requires strict compliance with international safety standards. IEC 60601-2-2 defines the particular requirements for the basic safety and essential performance of electrosurgical devices.

Our IEC 60601-2-2 testing services are designed specifically for manufacturers seeking CE marking, FDA 510(k) clearance, and global certification. We provide structured compliance support to help you reduce risk, avoid costly redesigns, and accelerate time to market.

sections.heading: What is IEC 60601-2-2?
paragraphs: IEC 60601-2-2 is a particular standard under the IEC 60601-1 series. It specifies additional safety requirements for high-frequency surgical equipment such as electrosurgical generators and RF surgical systems.
